name: kinoa-qa
description: QA plugin: testplan (Jira Story + PRD + OpenSpec specs -> Allure TestOps test cases), smoke-plan and smoke-run (Story smoke test in Jira), mcp-plan and mcp-run (Kinoa MCP story test plan and run)

plugins.name: kinoa-qa
plugins.description: QA skills: /kinoa-qa:testplan (test plan + TestOps case generator), /kinoa-qa:smoke-plan (Story -> Smoke test sub-task), /kinoa-qa:smoke-run (runs the smoke plan via the Playwright MCP, reports to Jira), /kinoa-qa:mcp-plan (test plan for a Kinoa MCP story) and /kinoa-qa:mcp-run (runs that plan through the kinoa connector, writes the test report)
